《Severance》頭兩季之間嘅等待已經夠耐，第三季同樣考驗緊大家嘅耐性，Apple TV 剛剛就劇集進度公布咗一個值得留意嘅消息。

"Severance" third season officially begins production, expected to premiere in late 2027

自從"Severance"第二季首播以來，已經相隔大約18個月。雖然第三季嘅進度未如理想，但啱啱達到咗一個重要里程碑。

According to a post on X by Ben Stiller (reposted by the Apple TV account), production on "Severance" season 3 has officially begun.

The low-resolution production photo Stiller shared appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running down a Lumon corridor, a scene reminiscent of one from the end of season two.

Season two ended with Mark's shocking decision — he chose to stay with Helly, going against his "outie's" original plan to reunite with Gemma, setting the stage for a string of compelling events in season three.

There was a three-year gap between the first and second seasons of 《Severance》. A number of factors were involved, including script revisions, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.

If season three requires six to nine months of filming, plus about half a year of post-production, 《Severance》 could very well return in autumn 2027. If so, it would be just a few months short of a full three years since the previous season.

When do you expect "Severance" season three to premiere? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
